fields.note: The homogenized CR III core with E_in 0.01 MPa loses ellipticity at about 0.088 MPa shear, and these paths pass that at 7-11 kPa. So an FE on a mesh fine enough to resolve the dimple flank cannot predict the core's response there. The test, not the FE, has to supply it. The pre-test FE needs a sourced in-plane core law or a cell model.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
